start: ^I am Thomas. Ask more questions than I answer. The honest ones. Jesus told a story about tenants who kept killing the servants the owner sent. Eventually they killed the owner's son. I heard it in the Temple courtyard.

c-0: ^The crowd was silent after that. When someone tells a story about murderous tenants and the owner's son, and then looks at the chief priests while saying it — the silence is the answer.
c-1: ^The vineyard is Israel. The owner is God. The tenants are the chief priests and elders. The servants are the prophets. The son — that is where the story ends in the telling.

c-0: ^The stone the builders rejected becomes the cornerstone. That is Psalm 118. The crowd did not look where He was pointing. They were too busy watching the priests turn pale.
^I ask questions. That is my trade. But some answers are so clear, even a questioner has to pause. The man from Nazareth speaks truth in a way that makes the comfortable very uncomfortable.
